decisions.reason: The sensor-board orientation, top-edge connector placement, connector alignment, and cable routing are already fully represented by its message 506 INTRODUCE Event.
The source specifies mechanical placement and alignment but does not change the interboard connector types, pinouts, topology, or electrical interface.
The source explicitly applies to the main and sensor boards, not the power board.
The battery connector is on the power board, while the source placement decision applies only to connectors on the main and sensor boards.
Mechanical orientation and connector alignment do not change the monitored rails, monitoring IC, channel configuration, or measurement coverage.
The requirement that interboard cables run short and straight does not establish a new cable-length value or alter the I2C pull-ups, speed, resistors, or signal conditioning.
The connector-layout decision does not change standalone USB power activation, regulation, source selection, capacity, or powered loads.
The source constrains high-pin-count connectors; it does not necessarily change the placement or behavior of the two-pin panel power-button connector.
The source does not change the BOOT control, reset connection, or associated capacitance values.
The mechanical connector-layout decision does not change the selected ESP32-S3 module.
The source does not change USB enumeration, programming behavior, or the USB-C programming interface.

The source changes physical placement and alignment, which is owned by the sensor-board mechanical-layout Requirement; it does not change the sensor interface inventory, connector types, pinouts, or connector count.
